title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.5 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It adds a deterministic repository-backed Custom GPT setup and evaluation package with strong Instructions, five Knowledge files, 27 serious evaluation cases, integrity checks, and the same canonical audit depths and output order as the local-only Pages Packet Builder. The GPT remains unpublished, adds no Action or verification API, and does not enlarge the Python engine's proof authority. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
